meta.name: brainstorming
meta.description: Explore user intent, requirements, and design options through collaborative dialogue before implementation. Use before building new features, components, or systems — whenever the user describes something to build and design decisions are involved. Triggers: "brainstorm", "help me design", "think through the requirements", "头脑风暴", "设计方案", "梳理需求". Not for bug fixes, config changes, or tasks with an obvious implementation path.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话梳理需求与设计方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在动手开发前需要理清思路和设计方向。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify requirements and design options through dialogue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to think through requirements and design before building.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先通过提问帮你理清想法，然后提出 2-3 个设计方案并推荐一个，最后编写设计文档。在获得你认可前不会写任何代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“头脑风暴”、“设计方案”、“梳理需求”等关键词，或要求设计新功能、系统时触发。不用于修 bug 或改配置。

say.text: 帮我设计一个待办事项应用
say.note: Claude 会先问需求，再给方案

say.text: 我们来头脑风暴一下这个聊天系统的架构
say.note: Claude 会探索方案并推荐

say.text: 梳理一下用户登录模块的需求
say.note: Claude 会提问并输出设计文档

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first ask questions to clarify your idea, then propose 2-3 design options with a recommendation, and finally write a design document. It will not write any code until you approve the design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like "brainstorm", "help me design", "think through the requirements", or ask to design a new feature or system. Not for bug fixes or config changes.

say_en.text: Help me design a to-do list app
say_en.note: Claude will ask requirements then propose options

say_en.text: Let's brainstorm the architecture of this chat system
say_en.note: Claude will explore options and recommend

say_en.text: Walk through the requirements for the login module
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions and output a design doc
